10k.note: FY2025 10-K. Three platforms: NeuroNova (CLD-101 partner-led), SuperNova (CLD-201, preclinical), RedTail (CLD-401, IND-enabling).

website.note: Pipeline page lists CLD-401 (IND enabling), CLD-501 (discovery), CLD-601 (discovery), NeuroNova (Phase 2), SuperNova (Phase 1). Phase progress bars are aspirational; 10-K is canonical.

ctgov.note: Zero results when querying 'Calidi Biotherapeutics' as lead sponsor (CLD-101 trials are sponsored by partners Northwestern University and City of Hope under the NSC-CRAd-S-pk7 designation, e.g. NCT05139056 Phase 1).

pipeline.modality: Allogeneic neural stem cells (NSC) loaded with engineered oncolytic adenovirus (CRAd-S-pk7); intracerebral administration into resection cavity
pipeline.target: Tumor-tropic NSC delivery of oncolytic adenovirus to glioma cells
pipeline.license_origin: Exclusive worldwide license (Northwestern University); partner-conducted clinical studies

indications.trial_name: Multiple Intracerebral Doses of NSC-CRAd-S-pk7 (Northwestern University)
indications.trial_design: Open-label Phase 1b/2 dose-escalation/expansion of multiple intracerebral doses in newly diagnosed HGG
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (Northwestern University-sponsored; FDA IND clearance announced; trial initiation Q1 2025 per company guidance)
key_milestones: Original first-in-human Phase 1 single-dose at Northwestern published 2021 (Lancet Oncology)

indications.trial_name: City of Hope Phase 1 of NSC-CRAd-S-pk7 in recurrent HGG
indications.trial_design: Single-arm Phase 1 dose-escalation in recurrent HGG; CIRM-funded
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (City of Hope; first patient dosed May 2023)

excluded_preclinical: CLD-201 (SuperNova) - vaccinia virus loaded into AD-MSC for solid tumors (breast, sarcoma, head & neck) - preclinical
CLD-401 (RedTail) - systemically delivered enveloped vaccinia carrying IL-15 superagonist for metastatic solid tumors - IND enabling
CLD-501 - myeloma/B-cell Trop-2 in-situ TCE with IL-15 superagonist payload - discovery
